The '''Haali''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Songbird/Legends|songbird]]<ref name="GCG" /> native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] species.<ref name="CSWE Ithor">{{CSWECite|II|123|Ithor}}</ref> Ithorian [[Gender/Legends|females]] sometimes had "Haali" as their given name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Haali was mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]] and published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
